prospective_rules.order: Pinned source order; no metric-based selection or tuning
prospective_rules.optimizer: Continue selected own weights and all AdamW moments; change learning rate prospectively to 1e-5 in v3 only
prospective_rules.new_data: Disjoint from first 4096 pretraining documents and both development splits
prospective_rules.quality: New development NLL gain >= max(1e-6, before*1e-5); no byte accuracy drop; historical NLL and accuracy cannot regress
prospective_rules.boundaries: Each program has its own durable ledger; preserve earlier cursors/rejections and unused data count; no rewinds
prospective_rules.stops: Three consecutive rejections or exhausted data terminates current program; fixed queue advances. Local resource limits and consent pause work without consuming new units. Finite queue exhaustion waits for new approved public food.
prospective_rules.physical_scope: Only two PCs available; software membership tests are not extra hardware
prospective_rules.source_transport: Pinned public upstream text via HTTPS on coordinator; datasets/gradients/own learned state between PCs only encrypted public LSP
prospective_rules.teachers: No teacher in this public food recipe; external distillation remains permitted by vision, not yet this queue
